title: 番外Ⅰ 项羽传Ⅵ
content_zh:
没多久之后虞姬就嫁给了项羽，这没有什么说的，这个时代项羽就是王，无冕之王，没有任何人能阻止他的信念，更何况虞姬也确实对他有好感。
“通知所有反秦诸侯就地等待。”在安居一段时间，各路诸侯都有些按捺不住想要去攻取关中的时候，项羽发话了。
范增苦涩着劝谏，然而并没有动摇项羽的想法，在项羽看来天下人九成九都是蝼蚁，刘邦作为自己的兄弟，自己为什么不帮忙呢？
“将军，你的兄弟是怎么样一个人？”虞姬被项羽拥在怀中，有些好奇的问道，项羽一直都无比的威严霸道，甚至于没有人敢于和这个雄伟的男子直视。
天下间只有两个人能项羽卸下霸道的神色，一个就是现在被他拥在怀中的虞姬，另一个便是项羽的兄弟刘邦。
“刘季啊，哈哈哈，他是一个非常有趣的家伙。”项羽笑着说道，“很快你就有机会见到他了。”
“很有趣？”虞姬偏头有些好奇，完全想不到那是什么概念，于是伸了伸胳膊嬉笑着说道，“夫君，我给你跳舞吧。”
一阙曼舞，虞姬缓缓地退到了帐后，她已经看到帐外等候的众将，这也是虞姬不仅仅讨项羽喜欢，诸将也都非常满意的地方。
“诸将何事？”项羽威严的说道，他现在坐镇于此就是为了弹压其他诸侯，让刘邦去奔赴咸阳，成功进入关中，否则就刘邦那么点功勋，要合情合理的封王，真心不容易。
当然项羽也可以强行给刘邦封王，不过这种做法名不正言不顺，项羽现在依旧保持着楚国贵族的骄傲，这种没有脸皮的行为还是尽量不要做。
至于现在这种以一人之力压住各路反秦诸侯，让其无法前进，虽说也有些不要面皮，但是至少能讲的过去，之前宋玉不也四十多天驻足吗，我们只是在休息。
“禀将军，刘邦于关中被章邯击败……”蒲将军低头不敢看项羽。
“啪！”项羽端着的青铜酒杯直接被捏成一团，“我兄弟被章邯击败了，章邯想死吗？”
全场无话可说，项羽的脑回路让众将有些无法跟上，不过这个时候范增却想到了另一方面。
“将军，我军趁此时机抄小路进兵咸阳，天下形势转瞬即可明朗，章邯既然在漳水大破刘邦，我军可先夺咸阳，后下诏夺降服章邯，此人可算是一员名将，又有数十万秦军，我军入手秦军，以将军威势，瞬即可夺天下！”范增上前一步说道。
项羽麾下众将并非是水货，范增如此计谋岂能不明，如此先吞秦后入手秦军，以秦军灭反秦义军，横竖伤亡不在自己，即可作为章邯之投诚表，又可稳定天下局势，虽然狠辣，但是却真是一战定鼎之策，因而皆是迈步上前，“将军，范军师此计上佳！”
“发兵。”项羽起身，“出兵棘原，命令刘邦走小路，兵袭咸阳！”

范增一口气堵在心口实在不知道该说什么了，在范增看来天下只需要一个老大，那就是项羽，其他只要是有危险的统统干掉。
“不可啊！将军，刘邦若是入了关中，我等该何处？”范增劝谏道，可惜项羽理也没理。

对于项羽来说没有什么该怎么处的问题，他项羽不需要任何外力，他自己就是最大的依凭，什么权力，什么兵势，什么名声，这些只要他项羽放下束缚，他的双拳足够教一切做人！
项羽进兵，其他诸侯自然也需要跟着，没一个敢跑的，当然刘邦已经收到了项羽的传信，虽说项羽在信里面狠狠的鄙视了一下刘邦的战斗力，但还是非常好心的让刘邦赶紧抄小路，自己去正面给他吸引火力。
“做兄弟的这次不能太过分，我给你弄了三万人过去，咸阳的兵力我都吸引到我这边了，要是这样你还是摆不平，那我也没什么办法了。”项羽在信中给刘邦交代好了，自己亲自去吸引火力。
果然等项羽到了漳水南，章邯就赶紧跑到了棘原，上一次项羽表现的太凶残了，虽说没有看到那个大石头碎城那一幕，但是流言还是有听到的。
虽说章邯不怎么相信人类能做到这一步，但不可否认项羽实在是太猛了，章邯不得不谨慎，一边赶紧固守营寨，一边又请求赵高赶紧调兵，结果项羽自己没有出手。
刘邦那边有了项羽的保证，自然是一路顺风，项羽的强大威慑力几乎将所有的火力都吸收了过去，然后刘邦在后方一路捡漏，成功的抵达了霸上。
自然子婴这个被赵高硬凑上来的三世干掉赵高后想也不想就投降了，刘邦成功进入了咸阳。
“项兄果然是信人，子房发信告诉项兄，我已经进入咸阳了，东西都给他封存了，让他记得给兄弟分封一个好地方，比方说川蜀商洛之地啦~”刘邦贼兴奋的说道，完全没想到这个弟兄这么给力。
“主公，您真的要放弃这块地方吗？”张良有些无奈的看着这个流氓君主说道。
“要也打不过他，再说我觉得他这个人这么讲义气也不会亏得我的，当初我在当泗水亭长的时候目标也不过是日日有酒有肉，现在娇妻美妾在怀，又有王位保证，找一个安全富庶的地方蹲上颐养天年比征战好的太多了。”刘邦大笑着说道，他真的满足了。
“我又比不上他勇猛，也没有他善战，更没有他年轻，我现在已经四十了，该养老了，区区一个泗水亭长，能平白入手一个王位有什么不满足的呢？”刘邦一甩袖子大笑着说道，“走，坐把龙椅，感受一下，我们就离开吧。”
张良，陈平等人皆是无奈，他们的理想也都实现了，至于樊哙，夏侯婴那些人更是无所谓了，刘邦的目标都达成了，他们的早就溢出了，所以刘邦要颐养天年，他们也乐的回家分田地，住大屋。
然而一切就是如此无奈，在刘邦坐到龙椅上准备指点江山的时候，一道金色的光泽缠了上来，骊山神女留下以秦国运数为核心的诅咒开启了。
【坐此位者，兄弟相残，妻妾相残，子孙相叛，祸乱相生，九世而废！】
“秦国这么快就亡了啊。”一身宫装的徐福长叹了一口气，“可惜了，当年被黄石阻了一阻，未给陛下炼成不死药，否则陛下也不需要长眠于地下了，唉……”
话说间宫装美女身上燃起了火焰，而她自己则无比的平静看着自己的身躯因为反噬一点点的化作劫灰，“这样也算是不负陛下了吧，可惜妾身没有来生，否则……”
公元前206年十月，在刘邦坐到秦王朝龙椅上感受的那一刻，骊山之上云成龙凤，关中大地皆可见，刘邦入主咸阳，项羽不日可至。

Not long after, Yu Ji married Xiang Yu. There is nothing to say about this. In this era, Xiang Yu is the king, the uncrowned king. No one can stop his belief, not to mention that Yu Ji does have a good impression of him.
"Inform all the anti-Qin princes to wait on the spot." After living in peace for a while, all the princes could not help but want to attack Guanzhong, Xiang Yu spoke.
Fan Zeng remonstrated bitterly, but did not sway Xiang Yu's idea. In Xiang Yu's view, 99% of the people in the world are ants. As Liu Bang's brother, why didn't he help?
"General, what kind of person is your brother?" Yu Ji was hugged by Xiang Yu and asked curiously. Xiang Yu had always been extremely majestic and domineering, and no one even dared to look directly at this majestic man.
There are only two people in the world who can remove Xiang Yu's domineering look. One is Yu Ji, who is currently in his arms, and the other is Xiang Yu's brother Liu Bang.
"Liu Ji, hahaha, he is a very interesting guy." Xiang Yu said with a smile, "You will have a chance to meet him soon."
"Very interesting?" Yu Ji tilted her head and was a little curious. She had no idea what it was, so she stretched out her arms and said with a smile, "Husband, let me dance for you."
After a dance, Yu Ji slowly retreated to the back of the tent. She had already seen the generals waiting outside the tent. This was where Yu Ji not only pleased Xiang Yu, but also the generals were very satisfied.
"What's the matter, generals?" Xiang Yu said majestically. He is here now to suppress other princes and let Liu Bang rush to Xianyang and successfully enter Guanzhong. Otherwise, with Liu Bang's little merit, it is really not easy to make him the king in a reasonable and reasonable manner.
Of course, Xiang Yu can also forcibly make Liu Bang the king, but this approach is unjust and unjust. Xiang Yu still maintains the pride of the Chu nobles, so he should try not to do this shameless behavior.
As for the current situation of suppressing all the anti-Qin princes with one person's power and preventing them from moving forward, although it is a bit shameless, it can at least be said to be past. Didn't Song Yu stop for more than forty days before? We were just resting.
"General, Liu Bang was defeated by Zhang Han in Guanzhong..." General Pu lowered his head and did not dare to look at Xiang Yu.
"Bang!" The bronze wine glass Xiang Yu was holding was crushed into a ball. "My brother was defeated by Zhang Han. Does Zhang Han want to die?"
There was nothing to say in the audience. Xiang Yu's brain circuit made it difficult for the generals to keep up. However, at this time, Fan Zeng thought of another aspect.
"General, our army took this opportunity to take a small road and march into Xianyang. The situation in the world will become clear in an instant. Since Zhang Han defeated Liu Bang at Zhangshui, our army can capture Xianyang first, and then issue an edict to capture and surrender Zhang Han. This man can be regarded as a famous general, and there are hundreds of thousands of Qin troops. Our army joins the Qin army, and with the power of the general, we can seize the world in an instant!" Fan Zeng stepped forward and said.
The generals under Xiang Yu were not parallel imports. How could Fan Zeng not know such a plan? To conquer Qin first and then attack the Qin army, and use the Qin army to destroy the rebel forces of Qin. Anyway, the casualties are not his own. This can serve as a sign of surrender to Zhang Han and stabilize the situation in the world. Although it is ruthless, it is a strategy that determines the outcome of the trip in one battle. Therefore, they all stepped forward and said, "General, this is a great plan, Master Fan!"
"Send troops." Xiang Yu stood up, "Send troops to Jiyuan, order Liu Bang to take the small road, and attack Xianyang!"

Fan Zeng felt a breath stuck in his heart and really didn't know what to say. In Fan Zeng's opinion, the world only needs one boss, and that is Xiang Yu. Anyone else who is in danger should be killed.
"No! General, if Liu Bang enters Guanzhong, where should we go?" Fan Zeng advised, but Xiang Yuli ignored him.
For Xiang Yu, there is no problem of what to do. He Xiang Yu does not need any external force. He himself is the biggest support. No matter what power, military strength, or reputation, as long as Xiang Yu lets go of his restraints, his fists are enough to teach everyone how to behave!When Xiang Yu marched into the army, other princes naturally had to follow him, and no one dared to run away. Of course, Liu Bang had already received Xiang Yu's letter. Although Xiang Yu severely despised Liu Bang's combat effectiveness in the letter, he was still very kind and asked Liu Bang to quickly take a small road and go to attract firepower to him head on.
"Brothers, don't go too far this time. I've sent you 30,000 people. I've attracted Xianyang's troops to my side. If you still can't deal with it, then there's nothing I can do." Xiang Yu told Liu Bang in the letter that he would personally attract the firepower.
Sure enough, when Xiang Yu arrived at Zhangshuinan, Zhang Han hurried to Jiyuan. Xiang Yu behaved too cruelly last time. Although he didn't see the scene where the big stone shattered the city, he still heard the rumors.
Although Zhang Han didn't really believe that humans could do this, it was undeniable that Xiang Yu was too powerful. Zhang Han had to be cautious. While quickly holding on to the camp, he asked Zhao Gao to quickly mobilize his troops, but Xiang Yu himself did not take action.
With Xiang Yu's guarantee on Liu Bang's side, it was naturally a smooth journey. Xiang Yu's powerful deterrence almost absorbed all the firepower, and then Liu Bang picked up leaks all the way from the rear and successfully arrived at Bashang.
Naturally, Ziying, the third generation who was forced by Zhao Gao, surrendered without thinking after killing Zhao Gao. Liu Bang successfully entered Xianyang.
"Brother Xiang is indeed a trustworthy person. Zifang sent a letter to tell Brother Xiang that I have entered Xianyang and sealed everything for him. He asked him to remember to entrust a good place to his brother, such as the land of Sichuan, Sichuan and Shangluo~" Liu Bang said excitedly. He did not expect this brother to be so capable.
"Lord, do you really want to give up this place?" Zhang Liang looked at the rogue monarch helplessly and said.
"I can't beat him. Besides, I don't think he will let me down if he is so loyal. When I was the head of the Surabaya pavilion, my goal was to have wine and meat every day. Now that I have a beautiful wife and concubine in my arms, and the throne is guaranteed, it is much better to find a safe and wealthy place to live until old age than to fight." Liu Bang said with a laugh, he was really satisfied.
"I'm not as brave as him, not as good at fighting, and not as young as him. I'm already forty now, and it's time to take care of myself. I'm just a pavilion chief in Surabaya. What's the point of being dissatisfied if I can get a throne for free?" Liu Bang rolled his sleeves and laughed and said, "Let's go, sit on the dragon chair, feel it, and let's leave."
Zhang Liang, Chen Ping and others are helpless, their ideals have been realized. As for Fan Kuai, Xia Houying and others, it doesn't matter anymore. Liu Bang's goals have been achieved, and their money has long been overflowing, so Liu Bang has to live a long life, and they are happy to go home to divide the fields and live in big houses.
However, everything was so helpless. When Liu Bang sat on the dragon throne and was about to point out the country, a golden luster wrapped around him, and the curse left by the goddess of Lishan with the destiny of Qin as its core was opened.
[Those who sit in this position will kill each other, their brothers will kill each other, their wives and concubines will kill each other, their descendants will rebel against each other, and disaster will happen to each other, and they will be destroyed in nine generations! 】
"The Qin Kingdom perished so quickly." Xu Fu, who was dressed in palace attire, sighed, "It's a pity that Huangshi blocked him from making the elixir for His Majesty. Otherwise, His Majesty wouldn't have to sleep underground. Alas..."
As she said this, the beauty in palace clothes was ignited with flames, but she herself was extremely calm as she watched her body turn into ashes bit by bit due to the backlash, "This can be regarded as living up to Your Majesty, but it is a pity that I will not have an afterlife, otherwise..."
In October 206 BC, at the moment when Liu Bang sat on the Dragon Throne of the Qin Dynasty and felt it, the clouds above Li Mountain turned into dragons and phoenixes, which could be seen all over Guanzhong. Liu Bang took over Xianyang, and Xiang Yu would not arrive soon.
